title: Own Your Data: Build an AI Workspace You Control
description:
This isn't your typical Obsidian graph or folder structure video.

Claude has some of the strongest data protections in the space. But that's on their end. Most people have no system underneath — no boundaries, no ownership, nothing portable.

I'm building a folder system that keeps your data yours and lets you carry it across any LLM. Documenting the whole build.

Follow along — subscribe and sign up for the newsletter at neo-pioneer.com so you don't miss it when the full breakdown drops.
